hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom swap curve between native ETH and phiEth token by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap, taking input from the PoolManager, converting via phiEth deposit/withdraw, and settling the output—no-oping the standard AMM concentrated liquidity swap. Direct liquidity addition is blocked; only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee are accepted.
